## Wave 7 Summary

The Landau classification document is the framework's canonical **framework↔condensed-matter mapping**: §I a ~30-row mapping table (each row tagged PROVEN / STRUCTURAL / OPEN / UNCOMPUTED at S44), §§II–VII prose (phase classification; one-body/many-body partition; specific-heat/DM-DE argument; occupied-state-spectral-action bridge; S45 predictions; limitations), Appendices A–C (Landau-paper equations, gate cross-reference, "what Landau would have said"). It calls itself a "living document updated each session" — and then stopped being updated for 49 sessions. In the interval S45→S93, the project produced a LARGE body of new framework↔Landau-CM physics that the document does not mention at all: the Leggett-channel dark-matter program (S49→S70 LEGGETT-MOMENT, the first Type-F DM mass anchor), the Volovik free-energy partition (S58/S62), the GGE two-fluid / generalized Landau-Khalatnikov dynamics (S67), the superfluid-stiffness anisotropy tensor (S47), BKT on the finite graph (S56/S58/S74), the BCS-BEC crossover relocation (S61), the 3He-B inheritance morphism + 4-gate falsifier protocol (S86/S87/S90 — a full cross-pillar bridge to a laboratory observable), the DILUTION-CC resolution of the CC universality-class-mismatch row (S66), the geometric (non-Kibble-Zurek) resolution of n_s (S57/S73a/S86), and a string of dedicated Landau-collab workshops (S52, S57, S58, S59, S73a, S75). The document also has hard drift: **OCC-SPEC-45 actually RAN and FAILED at S45** (S_occ monotone decreasing — the "28th equilibrium closure") — directly falsifying the document's §VI.A standing prediction of a non-monotone minimum near tau=0.19, which it calls "the single most important open computation in the framework."

This wave does THREE things in sequence, with the center of mass on **expansion (G2)**:
1. **G1 (SURVEY)** maps the whole framework↔Landau-CM DOMAIN across S45→S93 via the knowledge base and produces a GAP ANALYSIS — every existing row's current fate AND every new-since-S44 correspondence the project knows, each with a KB citation and a "where it belongs in the document."
2. **G2 (EXPAND)** comprehensively rewrites the document to integrate that gap: refresh all ~30 rows (drift-fixed, status-promoted), **add the new-correspondence rows + new prose sections**, deepen §§II–VII to current understanding, fold in the closed OCC-SPEC verdict + the post-S44 mechanism shifts, in Landau's voice with the substrate-IS direction restored.
3. **G3 (RECONCILE+VERIFY)** is the QA pass over the expanded document: every claim (retained + new) current, framing-compliant, provenance-traced, `a_n^{regulator}`-tagged where applicable.

## Wave 7 Decision Point Prerequisites

**None — Wave 7 is independent.** No upstream verdict from S93-or-earlier or from any other session-x wave gates any W7 gate. The three gates form an internal SURVEY → EXPAND → VERIFY chain (G2 consumes G1's gap analysis; G3 consumes G2's expanded document), but that chain is wholly within this wave. The aggregate-sourcing discipline (context §1, §5) means W7 mines the KB and does NOT read sessions linearly and does NOT depend on any other document's update. W7 feeds W9 (cross-document closeout) but is not fed by it. Per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md`, no prereq-block closure is anticipated for this wave.

## §W7-1. WX-W7-1 — AGGREGATE-DOMAIN-SURVEY

```yaml
# ---- Identity (4 fields) ----
gate_id: "WX-W7-1"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "AUDIT"
classification: "PHONONIC"
agent_type: "landau-condensed-matter-theorist"
hypothesis: "The whole-project (S45→S93) framework↔Landau-condensed-matter DOMAIN can be mapped against the knowledge base such that (a) every existing §I mapping-table row + §§II–VII prose claim has its current S93 fate determined with a KB citation, AND (b) every NEW framework↔CM correspondence established since S44 is enumerated as a gap row with a KB citation and a 'where it belongs in the document' placement — producing a state-of-domain map + gap analysis that is the engine for the G2 comprehensive expansion."

method:
  description: >
    WHOLE-DOMAIN survey, NOT a claim-by-claim audit (context §5). Sweep the knowledge
    base broadly across the framework↔Landau-condensed-matter subject area for ALL of
    S45→S93 via the knowledge MCP. The survey produces TWO artifacts:
      (1) state_of_domain_map.json — current S93 state of the Landau-CM domain: every
          existing §I row's fate (CURRENT / SUPERSEDED / STALE-by-precision / CONTRADICTED /
          CONDITIONAL) with the closing/refining gate + Landau paper; every §§II–VII prose
          claim's current value.
      (2) gap_analysis.json — the gap between "what the project knows in this domain" and
          "what the document covers": every NEW-since-S44 correspondence (table B seed + the
          rest the sweep finds) as a row {correspondence, cm_concept, session_gate_citation,
          landau_paper, doc_placement, proposed_status_tag}, PLUS every existing row needing
          refresh {row, s44_status, current_state, verdict_class, citation}.
    Query plan (extend well beyond the seed — tens of queries per context §5):
      search_knowledge over: "BCS Cooper pairing gap"; "superfluid two-fluid Leggett dark
        matter"; "Landau free energy phase transition universality"; "Fermi liquid Pomeranchuk
        effective mass"; "Kibble-Zurek quench n_s tilt"; "GGE Richardson-Gaudin Ordered Veil";
        "Ginzburg-Landau coherence penetration BKT vortex"; "3He-B BDI inheritance falsifier";
        "Volovik partition condensation energy"; "second sound Mott OES gap"; "BCS-BEC crossover
        GPE"; "Kohn anomaly modulus softening Ginzburg number"; "Leggett Goldstone mass phason";
        "alpha_s running Mellin n_s squared"; "DM DE ratio specific heat alpha"; "level statistics
        Poisson Brody Thouless"; + any sub-topic these surface.
      trace_entity over each major mechanism: "OCC-SPEC", "LEGGETT-MOMENT", "Volovik partition",
        "DILUTION-CC", "BCS-CLASS", "3He-B inheritance", "GGE permanence", "n_s tilt",
        "superfluid stiffness", "BKT", "Pomeranchuk".
      list_entities("theorems") / ("closed") / ("gates") / ("open") — what exists now in-domain.
      get_constant over each constant the domain touches: tau_fold, Delta_BCS, E_cond,
        Q_Leggett, omega_L1, m_L1, c_Gold, M_max, xi_BCS, Omega_DM, Omega_DE_obs, eps_H,
        r_POISSON_canonical, n_s_framework, alpha_s_canonical — current value + Superseded flag.
    Record the full query manifest in the WP MCP Pre-Compute Audit block (mandatory per
    workingpaper.md Rule 3). A gap row without a KB citation is "imagined" (derivative-output
    discipline) and FAILS the gate.
  producing_script: "computations/session-x/sx_w7_domain_survey.py"

# (1) operator — the mathematical comparison form
operator:
  type: "set"
  form: "PASS iff domain_entity_classes_surveyed ⊇ {theorems, closed, gates, open, constants, equations} over Landau-CM topic set AND gap_analysis = (existing_row_refresh_set ∪ new_correspondence_set) is enumerated with a KB citation per row. coverage-by-enumeration."

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary — exact threshold value + direction
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: >
    (i) every one of the ~30 existing §I rows has a fate-verdict row in state_of_domain_map
    with a KB citation; (ii) every §§II–VII prose seed-claim (≥ the list in §A) has a current
    value; (iii) the new-correspondence set in gap_analysis contains AT LEAST the table-B seed
    set (14 correspondences) AND any further correspondences the sweep surfaces, each with a KB
    citation + doc_placement; (iv) the kb_query_manifest contains ≥ 25 distinct queries spanning
    ≥ 5 entity classes. A survey that only re-checks existing claims (no new-correspondence set)
    FAILS by pre-registration.
  direction: ">="

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically — is the threshold analytically derived?
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "coverage-by-enumeration"

# (4) reachable_rationals — does the admissible region contain a rational mesh?
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "N/A — synthesis/expansion gate"

# (5) machinery_pin_map — every free parameter of producing_script, pinned
machinery_pin_map:
  kb_tools: "[search_knowledge, trace_entity, list_entities, get_constant, query_entity]"
  kb_entity_classes: "[theorems, closed, gates, open, constants, equations, sessions]"
  kb_query_manifest: "recorded in WP MCP Pre-Compute Audit block; >= 25 distinct queries; >= 5 entity classes"
  domain_scope: >
    framework <-> Landau-condensed-matter mapping: phase transitions / order parameters /
    universality classes; superfluidity (two-fluid, second sound, critical velocity, Leggett);
    superconductivity (BCS gap, GL, BDI/AZ, Cooper, Meissner, BKT); Fermi-liquid (Landau params,
    effective mass, Pomeranchuk); Ginzburg-Landau (coherence/penetration length, vortices, Ginzburg
    number, Kohn anomaly); topological vacuum (3He-B, momentum-space invariants, inheritance morphism);
    critical dynamics (Kibble-Zurek, Landau-Khalatnikov, critical slowing); GGE / Richardson-Gaudin
    integrability / Ordered Veil; BCS-BEC crossover; specific-heat exponent / DM-DE.
  gap_taxonomy: >
    existing-row verdict ∈ {CURRENT, SUPERSEDED, SUPERSEDED-by-mechanism-shift, SUPERSEDED-context,
    STALE-by-precision, CONTRADICTED, CONDITIONAL, PROMOTED}; new-correspondence row carries
    {correspondence, cm_concept, session_gate_citation, landau_paper, doc_placement, proposed_status}.
  canonical_constants_snapshot: "computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py @ <computed-at-runtime>"
  document_pre_sha: "<computed-at-runtime>"
  N_eval: "N/A — survey gate"
  L_max: "N/A"
  scan_range: "N/A"
  step_size: "N/A"
  tolerance: "N/A — coverage-by-enumeration, no numerical comparison"
  scheme: "AGGREGATE-DOMAIN-SURVEY"
  convention: "substrate-IS-direction-per-phononic-framing"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "N/A"

# (6) audit_discriminators — which inputs feed audit_sha256 vs content_sha256
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["document_pre", "state_of_domain_map", "gap_analysis", "canonical_constants_snapshot", "kb_query_manifest"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["state_of_domain_map", "gap_analysis"]

# (7) substitution_chain — mandatory for sign/direction/threshold claims
substitution_chain:
  required: false
  content: |
    G1 is a coverage/enumeration gate; it asserts no sign/direction/ratio claim of its own.
    Any directional claim CARRIED INTO a gap row (e.g. "G_N ratio increases with Λ from 2.29 to 26.8";
    "DM/DE = 2.7x of observation") is recorded as an OBSERVED KB value with citation, not derived here;
    the substitution-chain obligation for those falls on G2 (where the claim is written into the document).

# (8) input_files — every file the producing_script reads, with SHA pin
input_files:
  document_under_expansion:
    path: "sessions/framework/Classification-of-phonon-exflation.md"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"
  canonical_constants:
    path: "computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"
  knowledge_db:
    path: "tools/knowledge.db"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"

# ---- Output artifacts ----
output_artifacts:
  script:
    path: "computations/session-x/sx_w7_domain_survey.py"
    artifact_kind: "script"
    must_contain:
      - "from canonical_constants import"

    optional: false
  verdict_line:
    path: "computations/session-x/sx_gate_verdicts.txt"
    artifact_kind: "verdict_line"
    must_contain: "^WX-W7-1:.* audit_sha256=[a-f0-9]{64}"
    companion_row_required: true
    schema_v2_3tuple_required: false
  wp_section:
    path: "sessions/session-x/session-x-w7-workingpaper.md"
    artifact_kind: "wp_section"
    section_anchor: "### §W7-1. WX-W7-1"
    must_contain:
      - "\\*\\*Status\\*\\*:.*COMPLETED"
      - "\\*\\*Verdict\\*\\*:.*(PASS|FAIL|INFO)"
      - "\\*\\*Output Artifacts\\*\\*"
      - "\\*\\*MCP Pre-Compute Audit\\*\\*"

# ---- Verdict rubric (3 fields) ----
PASS_meaning: "The Landau-CM domain is mapped across S45→S93: existing-row fates + new-correspondence set both enumerated with citations. The expansion now has its engine — G2 knows exactly what to refresh and what to add."
FAIL_meaning: "The survey is incomplete — either an existing row's fate is undetermined, OR (the structural failure this gate guards against) the new-correspondence set is empty/absent and the survey merely re-checked existing claims. A reconcile-only survey FAILS."
INFO_meaning: "Survey covers the domain but a bounded number of gap rows lack a clean KB citation (flagged for G2 to resolve at write-time via additional targeted queries)."

# ---- Effort + framing (2 fields) ----
effort:
  files_created:
    - "computations/session-x/sx_w7_domain_survey.py"
    - "computations/session-x/sx_w7_state_of_domain_map.json"
    - "computations/session-x/sx_w7_gap_analysis.json"
  estimated_time: "0.5 day (heavy KB sweep — tens of queries)"

substrate_framing: |
  The domain is the substrate's condensed-matter STRUCTURE: the eigenvalue spectrum of D_K on
  Jensen-deformed SU(3) IS the order-parameter manifold (τ), the BCS gap Δ(τ) IS the
  superconducting order parameter on the fiber, the Leggett inter-band mode IS a phason of the

  Direction flows FROM the substrate spectral triple TOWARD the CM classification — never the
  reverse (no "the substrate behaves like a superconductor"; rather "the substrate IS a spectral
```

## Wave 7 → Wave 9 Decision Point

W7 feeds W9 (cross-document consistency + coverage closeout over the 8 expanded docs); it is not fed by W9. The handoff to W9:

- **WX-W7-2 PASS** → the expanded Classification-of-phonon-exflation.md is registered as W7's deliverable for W9's SHARED-CONSTANT-MATRIX gate (W9 cross-checks that this doc's refreshed constants — Delta_BCS=0.4642547, E_cond=-0.137, tau_fold=0.19, Q_Leggett=670000, m_L1=0.070, c_Gold=0.915, Mass_LeggettDM/Δ_BCS=11.97, n_s=0.9567 — agree with the values cited in the W1/W3/W4/W5/W6 expanded docs). Any cross-doc constant disagreement W9 finds routes back as a W7 hot-fix.
- **WX-W7-2 INFO** (bounded gap rows scoped-out) → the scoped-out set is handed to W9's COVERAGE-CONSISTENCY gate, which verifies the scoped-out items are covered (or consistently scoped-out) across the doc set.
- **WX-W7-3 PASS** → the doc enters W9 coverage-consistency clean (no stale/unframed/untraced claims to propagate cross-doc).
